status: Independent illustrative study. Unaffiliated with the City, TTC, Metrolinx and election campaigns.

sources.title: Mississauga Moves 2.0 announcement
sources.supports: Current campaign proposal: Line 2 from Kipling through Sherway into downtown Mississauga; proposes a business case rather than selecting an alignment.
sources.limits: Campaign advocacy, not a City/TTC/Metrolinx decision. No verified matching Carolyn Parrish subway announcement was found in this bounded search.

sources.title: Mississauga Moves 2.0 plan
sources.supports: Business case to choose route, stations and terminus; examine Dundas alongside other options, tunnelling/elevated construction, fleet, power, signalling, Line 2 capacity and western yard.
sources.limits: Do not attribute authored map or named map locations to an officially selected campaign route. No detailed route map appears in the relevant plan pages.

sources.title: EX12.5 Prioritization of Planned Higher-Order Transit Projects
sources.supports: Adopted recommendation 7 requested a report by Q3 2025 on Etobicoke transit needs including timing and approach to a Line 2 extension to Sherway.
sources.limits: Reporting direction, not construction approval or a City Centre alignment. No later completed Sherway business case or approval established in this review.

sources.title: Rapid Transit Expansion Study: Executive Summary
sources.publisher: Toronto Transit Commission / City of Toronto; archival copy hosted by Transit Toronto
sources.supports: ES14 shows shorter western options; ES15 shows City Centre D3 and explicitly screens it out. Narrative cites then-regional priorities and length/cost for short/medium-term staging.
sources.limits: Historical assumptions. Filename rtes2002.pdf is not the internal study date. D1/D2 labels and distances vary between narrative, summary table and figures; use named destinations rather than reproduce precise costs or lengths.

sources.title: Rapid Transit Expansion Study — Screening of Options
sources.supports: Official dated board-report provenance for 2001 screening and executive summary.
sources.limits: Staff recommendations are not evidence that a Mississauga extension was funded.

sources.title: Historical Background on Rapid Transit in Mississauga
sources.supports: Public retrospective describes 1993 western-extension EA, later 2001 assessment, and says its records search found no government offer to extend the subway at no cost to Mississauga.
sources.limits: Historical cost and travel-time estimates are not current. No-record-found is narrower than proof no offer ever existed.

sources.title: Dundas Connects Phase 2 Open House Panels, Part 2
sources.date: 2016–2018 consultation period; exact panel date not established
sources.supports: Bottom panel compares 1993 TTC EA route via East Mall, West Mall and Dixie with a Dundas subway alternative to Cooksville GO.
sources.limits: Consultation alternatives, not the adopted plan. Upload directory 2021 is not study date. Original panel has schematic geography and historical LRT stop arrangement.

sources.title: Dundas Connects
sources.supports: Adopted direction includes BRT, mixed-use growth, cycling and pedestrian improvements.
sources.limits: Two official pages disagree June18 versus June20; use month/year unless council minutes resolve exact day.

sources.title: Building the Dundas Bus Rapid Transit
sources.date: Undated live project page; checked 2026-09-27 UTC
sources.supports: Mississauga East is the first construction segment planned; dedicated median bus lanes; construction schedule under development.
sources.limits: Do not carry forward an older 2024 page’s anticipated 2026 construction start as a verified current start or claim the full 48 km is funded.

sources.title: Dundas Bus Rapid Transit environmental assessment
sources.supports: Mississauga East environmental report completed; segment Etobicoke Creek to Confederation Parkway.
sources.limits: Environmental-report completion is not construction completion.

sources.title: Dundas BRT
sources.date: Undated live project page; checked 2026-09-27 UTC
sources.supports: 48 km corridor to Kipling; links to HML; initial business case supports improved bus infrastructure.
sources.limits: BRT forecasts do not establish demand for a subway. Funding and design differ by segment.

sources.title: Downtown Mobility Hub and Transitway Connection
sources.supports: Assessment and preliminary design underway around Rathburn, Station Gate and Centre View; links to future developments and Transitway.
sources.limits: Bus/transit hub project, not a subway approval.

sources.title: Downtown Mobility Hub & Transitway Connection PIC1 panels
sources.supports: Existing City Centre Transit Terminal at capacity; planned integration of MiWay/GO buses, LRT pedestrian connection and Transitway. Future funding/design/procurement stages shown.
sources.limits: No subway reference; capacity statement is about bus terminal, not proof of subway ridership.

sources.title: Hazel McCallion Line
sources.date: Undated live project page; checked 2026-09-27 UTC
sources.supports: 18 km/19-stop core line planned to link Lakeshore West and Milton GO, Transitway, MiWay and Brampton services.
sources.limits: Future service; do not imply open, assume opening date, or merge separate downtown-loop status into core scope.

sources.title: Mississauga Official Plan 2051, Chapter12 Downtown Core
sources.supports: Highest-density mixed-use centre; growth and transit connections; need to balance housing with employment; Rathburn/StationGate terminal.
sources.limits: Policy direction and anticipated growth do not themselves establish subway cost-effectiveness; avoid assertion about this chapter’s current legal force without separate plan-status verification.

sources.title: City unveils vision to transform downtown core
sources.supports: Council-endorsed vision for 12 acres near City Hall including housing, offices, hotel/convention and cultural uses.
sources.limits: Vision for further analysis, business cases and delivery strategy; not all approved/funded buildings.

sources.title: City outlines advocacy priorities ahead of 2026 Provincial budget
sources.supports: Requests HML downtown-loop implementation/timing, all-day Milton GO and further DundasBRT east-to-Kipling/west-to-UTM studies.
sources.limits: Advocacy requests do not prove secured funding or announced completion dates.
